description: This file defines a UI component for a checkout modal in a furniture shopping web application. It uses LightningJS library to build the visual component structure, manage state, handle interactions, and subscribe to application store updates. The component includes form fields, summary display, and action buttons for cancelling or placing an order.

classes.name: CheckoutModal
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the checkout modal, managing form data, layout, and interactions within the shopping application.

methods.name: focusField
methods.description: Sets the input focus to the specified form field.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the checkout modal by invoking the AppStore method.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Submits the order via the AppStore, after validating form inputs.
